display.$description: Default UI display face: Storm Sans with normal leading. Size and weight come from the component. Use it for headings, labels and other short, prominent UI text such as titles, buttons, tags and toggles. Used by HeadingText (`base` variant, all levels), LabelText, Button, LinkText, Tag, Toggle, Breadcrumb, TypeTable and CodeBlock/CreditCardInput chrome.

editorial.$description: Editorial display face: Storm Serif with normal leading. Size and weight come from the component. Use it for long-form, content-led headings such as article, blog and marketing page titles, where a warmer, bookish tone fits better than `display`. Used by HeadingText's `editorial` variant for the larger levels; the smallest levels fall back to `display` for legibility.

body.$description: Running-text face: Storm Sans with snug leading. Size and weight come from the component. Use it for paragraphs, descriptions and other multi-line reading copy, from dense table rows and sidebars to article body text. Used by BodyText, LinkText and Breadcrumb.

caption.$description: Supporting-text face: Storm Sans italic with snug leading. Size and weight come from the component. Use it for secondary, low-emphasis text that annotates something else, such as helper and validation messages, small labels, value readouts and metadata. Used by Field helper and validation text, ValidationText, Badge, Slider value labels, ColorPicker and EyebrowText.

eyebrow.$description: Kicker face: Google Sans Code with no extra leading, so it sits tight against the content below. Size and weight come from the component. Use it for the short, usually uppercase category or section label placed directly above a heading. Used by EyebrowText.

code.$description: Monospace face: Google Sans Code with snug leading. Size and weight come from the component. Use it for anything that must keep fixed-width alignment or reads as a literal value, such as source code, file paths, identifiers, keyboard input, card numbers and step counters. Used by CodeBlock, InlineCodeText, FileTree, FilePicker, Stepper, CreditCardInput and code content inside Accordion.

container.$description: Corner radius for large framed regions that group other content (8px, `border-radius.lg`). Used by Container, Accordion, Callout, CodeBlock, FileTree, FilePicker, Table, Stepper and InlineCodeText.

trigger.$description: Corner radius for triggers interfaces (6px, `border-radius.sm`). Used by Tabs (indicators).

card.$description: Corner radius for cards and card-like tiles (6px, `border-radius.md`). Slightly tighter than `container` so cards nested inside a container still read as inset. Used by Card and FilePicker.

button.$description: Corner radius for triggers and other pressable elements (8px, `border-radius.lg`). Used by Button, Badge, DatePicker triggers, SearchInput results, Select items, Tabs triggers and CodeBlock header controls. Circular and rounded Button variants override it.

tag.$description: Corner radius for tags (6px, `border-radius.md`). Used by Tag.

control.$description: Corner radius for form controls that accept input (8px, `border-radius.lg`). Matches `button` so inputs and buttons line up when placed side by side. Used by Input, TextArea, Select, Field, RadioGroup and Rating.

checkbox.$description: Corner radius for the checkbox box (6px, `border-radius.md`). Kept smaller than `control` so the small box still reads as a square rather than a pill. Used by Checkbox.

tab.$description: Corner radius for inset tabs and toggle indicators (4px, `border-radius.sm`). Used by Tabs, Toggle and ToggleGroup items.

tabs.$description: Corner radius for frames that contain inset tab-like controls (6px, `border-radius.md`). Used by Tabs headers, Toggle and ToggleGroup.

dialog.$description: Corner radius for modal dialogs (12px, `border-radius.xl`). Larger than other surfaces to set modal content apart from the page beneath it. Used by Dialog.

sheet.$description: Corner radius for sheets (0px, `border-radius.zero`). Sheets slide in flush against a viewport edge, so their corners stay square. Applied by Sheet to its exposed corners.

drawer.$description: Corner radius for drawers (32px, `border-radius.4xl`). The large rounding marks a panel that slides over the page from an edge. Used as the default `borderRadius` of Drawer.

popover.$description: Corner radius for popovers and dropdown menus (6px, `border-radius.md`). Used by Popover and the Select dropdown list.

tooltip.$description: Corner radius for tooltips (6px, `border-radius.md`). Used by Tooltip.
